bugs.what: Taking 'a headframe lantern, unlit' at The Head-Frame (Iron Downs) showed no '(NPC watching: taking it is theft...)' warning like every other pickup with a witness in the game, yet it silently counted as theft and cost Tamsin's regard (-1) immediately after.

confusions: The headframe lantern pickup gave no theft warning before taking it, unlike the consistent pattern elsewhere, so the companion disapproval afterward felt like it came from nowhere.
suggestions: Add the standard '(NPC watching: taking it is theft...)' tag to every witnessed pickup, including the headframe lantern, so theft consequences are always signposted before the action.

Surface which specific settled griefs count toward the 'hollows rested' tally in status (e.g. clarify whether a shrine/crypt inside a hold counts as its own hollow or is folded into the parent hold), since my personal count of rested locations ran ahead of the displayed tally.
The 'weigh what this grief asks' and 'get your bearings' free actions are excellent for orientation — more locations could surface them earlier (some rooms only reveal them after wandering a bit).
